title: Pathing Plus
description: Plan your route before you commit. Pin map nodes to compare the routes through them, see a table of what each route offers (elites, fires, chests...), and zoom out to view the whole map at once. Works with mouse or controller. Informational only.
changeNote: v0.12.1 - Settings menu (the gear beside Zoom) now opens clear of the legend, adds sliders for framing the rotated map view, and has a Reset to defaults row. Nicer trail defaults out of the box. The Zoom button's controller glyph appears and disappears as you switch between pad and mouse. Also since v0.11.0: Auto Path Mode for planning by hand, live trail-geometry sliders, legend row highlighting, and gamepad double-tap to pin a whole node type.
